تشترطن (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِطْنَ (taštariṭna) /taʃ.ta.ritˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# تُشْتَرَطْنَ (tuštaraṭna) /tuʃ.ta.ratˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
